title: FinRobot Gate Decision
description: Pass/human-review/fail decision for one audit run. Planned for PR3+. A gate decision is the final output of the reliability scorecard + threshold evaluation.

decision.description: PASS: meets all threshold targets. HUMAN_REVIEW: borderline — analyst should check. FAIL: one or more hard failure conditions met.

scorecard_ref.description: Path to the reliability_scorecard.json that drove this decision, e.g. 'output/NVDA/NVDA_reliability_scorecard.json'.

hard_failures.description: Any condition that forces FAIL regardless of scorecard. E.g. 'missing_data_cutoff', 'unsupported_recommendation', 'source_hierarchy_violation'.
